scenes.title: Open-source product demos
scenes.talkingPoints: Lead with the product category, ownership model, and zero-backend boundary.
scenes.narration: ScreenReel is an open-source demo recorder that ships with your product. No account, backend, or hosted workspace.

actions.text: Apache 2.0 and self-hosted: no account, backend, or hosted workspace.

scenes.talkingPoints: Reorder a scene, then capture highlight and spotlight actions on stable real targets.
scenes.narration: When a moment needs emphasis, point at the real element and capture a highlight or spotlight. Your demo remains a readable flow in the repository.

scenes.talkingPoints: Show live playback, self-playing link, rendered video, and the repository source together.
scenes.narration: That one flow now plays live inside the product, opens as a self-playing link, and renders to video. Projector, Studio, and Capture share the same source.
